mentions.name: Blackshift
mentions.description: A Steam game that has been in continuous development since its 2020 release, with ongoing additions and tweaks such as the newly added 'flip-flops': mirrors that spin when shot, named for working like flip-flops from computing. The developer is also exploring new game ideas aimed at reaching a popular audience.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been updating my game Blackshift (https://store.steampowered.com/app/741110/Blackshift/).

It released in 2020 but I've never stopped adding things and tweaking it. Recently I added mirrors that spin when you shoot them, called "flip-flops" because they work a bit like flip-flops from computing.
